title: After the 8:30 candle, the other side almost always gets taken

hero.caption: of the time the **opposite side** of the 8:30 news candle gets hit the same session. A one-way day is the exception.

chart.label: How often the other side gets taken — by event
chart.sub: Opposite side of the 08:30 ET candle touched, 08:31–17:00
chart.note: Bigger the data, wider the 8:30 candle and the longer before it flips — CPI/NFP take ~1h, Jobless Claims ~18 min.

useIt: When a side of the 8:30 candle breaks, the first move is real but rarely the only one — the other side gets taken too, almost every time. The bigger the release, the wider the candle and the longer it commits before reversing.
disclaimer: Not advice · AI-backtested on 10y NQ · check it yourself
